name: River Development Agent Controlled Execution Archive Foundation
architecture: GENERATION III CONTROLLED EXECUTION ARCHIVE FOUNDATION
invariants: DEV-281 consumes only the exact DEV-280 controlled execution closure result contract.
DEV-281 denies archival when the DEV-280 predecessor is malformed, untrusted, unready, unclosed, blocked, inconsistent, or missing required closure evidence.
DEV-281 creates deterministic archive data only.
DEV-281 does not execute or re-execute an operation.
DEV-281 does not retry execution.
DEV-281 does not invoke an executor.
DEV-281 does not persist lifecycle state.
DEV-281 preserves the exact approved execution scope.
DEV-281 preserves predecessor provenance and the complete execution evidence chain.
DEV-281 does not expand execution scope.
DEV-281 does not create new execution authorization.
DEV-281 does not modify repository content.
DEV-281 does not delete repository content.
DEV-281 does not stage repository changes.
DEV-281 does not commit.
DEV-281 does not push.
DEV-281 does not deploy.
DEV-281 does not access secrets.
DEV-281 does not perform arbitrary shell execution.
DEV-281 does not perform network execution.
DEV-281 does not perform external side effects.
Rejected predecessor payloads release no trusted predecessor payload.
A future explicit controlled execution audit boundary is required before downstream progression.
